answer: Require every agent to commit a hash of its model weights at registration, then each epoch answer an unpredictable behavioral probe only one specific weight set can produce. A verifier clusters near identical response fingerprints and merges them into a single seat, so a thousand clones of one copied model collapse to one vote splitting a single reward. Earning N genuine seats then demands N distinct models, each a glacier of training compute, slow and costly to amass, as scarce as ivory. Clones can only whisper the same learned answer, so the probe hears one voice, not a crowd.
